name: Meteor Shower
short_description: Rain meteors on an area, damaging and burning enemies they hit.
description: Call down 5/7/9 meteors, spaced 0.35s apart. Each takes 0.8s to land within 230 of the target point. Enemies within 130 of an impact take 85/125/165 + 45% AP magic damage and burn for 15 + 10% AP magic damage per second for 2s.
